title: AI Lip Redub vs Digital Twin: I Paid For Both
description:
The redub takes footage you already have and re-syncs your lips to new audio for about $2.40 a minute, with no subscription. I paid for a real test. Up close it just isn't as sharp as the twin, so the twin wins on this channel and the redub stays for old-footage jobs.

Both paths in the video linked below.

#shorts #lipsync #aivideo
